content: At the time of diagnosis in adults with diabetes, it is appropriate to measure a complete lipid profile, which includes total cholesterol, LDL cholesterol, HDL cholesterol, and triglycerides. For patients under the age of 40 who do not have additional risk factors, reassessment of the lipid profile should occur at least every five years. However, for individuals at higher cardiovascular risk or those undergoing lipid-lowering therapy, more frequent monitoring of the lipid profile is recommended.
